facts.business: Parag Milk Foods Limited is a leading private-sector dairy FMCG company in India with a fully integrated value chain connecting over half a million rural farmers to advanced manufacturing facilities, offering products across 20+ consumer-focused categories under four power brands: Gowardhan, Go, Pride of Cows, and Avvatar.
key_risks: Valuation of trade receivables involving significant management judgment on recoverability and impairment provisions
Working capital management dependent on cash collection from trade receivables
